```{r}

gish_p_gi <- abcd_load(raw_path("gish_p_gi.csv"))
gish_y_gi <- abcd_load(raw_path("gish_y_gi.csv"))
gish_p_sex <- abcd_load(raw_path("gish_p_sex.csv"))
gish_y_sex <- abcd_load(raw_path("gish_y_sex.csv"))

pgi <- gish_p_gi |>
    dplyr::select(
        "eventname",
        "subjectkey",
        "demo_sex_v2", # what is their assigned sex
        "demo_gender_id_v2", # what is their gender
        "demo_gender_id_v2_l", # what is their gender (l)
        "kbi_p_c_trans", # are they trans
        "kbi_p_c_trans_l" # are they trans (l)
    ) |>
    dplyr::rename(
        "p_sex" = "demo_sex_v2",
        "p_gender" = "demo_gender_id_v2",
        "p_gender_l" = "demo_gender_id_v2_l",
        "p_trans" = "kbi_p_c_trans",
        "p_trans_l" = "kbi_p_c_trans_l"
    )

colnames(pgi)

ygi <- gish_y_gi |>
    dplyr::select(
        "eventname",
        "subjectkey",
        "kbi_sex_assigned_at_birth", # what is their assigned sex
        "kbi_gender", # what is their gender
        "kbi_y_trans_id" # what is their gender (l)
    ) |>
    dplyr::rename(
        "y_sex" = "kbi_sex_assigned_at_birth",
        "y_gender" = "kbi_gender",
        "y_trans" = "kbi_y_trans_id"
    )
ygi <- ygi |>
    dplyr::mutate(
        y_gender = dplyr::case_when(
            y_gender == 1 ~ "boy",
            y_gender == 2 ~ "girl",
            y_gender == 3 ~ "nb",
            y_gender == 4 ~ "don't know",
            y_gender == 5 ~ "no answer",
            TRUE ~ NA
        )
    )
ygi3 <- ygi |>
    dplyr::filter(eventname == "3_year_follow_up_y_arm_1") |>
    dplyr::select("subjectkey", "y_gender") |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(y_gender))
ygi4 <- ygi |>
    dplyr::filter(eventname == "4_year_follow_up_y_arm_1") |>
    dplyr::select("subjectkey", "y_gender") |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(y_gender))
colnames(ygi3) <- c("subjectkey", "gender3")
colnames(ygi4) <- c("subjectkey", "gender4")
ygi_full <- na.omit(dplyr::full_join(ygi3, ygi4, by = "subjectkey"))
ygi_mismatch <- ygi_full |>
    dplyr::filter(gender3 != gender4)

ygi_full

ygi |>
    dplyr::group_by(y_sex) |>
    dplyr::summarize(n = dplyr::n())

ygi_mismatch

ygi_mismatch |>
    dplyr::filter(gender3 == "boy") |>
    dplyr::group_by(gender4) |>
    dplyr::summarize(n = dplyr::n())

ygi_mismatch |>
    dplyr::filter(gender3 == "girl") |>
    dplyr::group_by(gender4) |>
    dplyr::summarize(n = dplyr::n())

ygi_mismatch |>
    dplyr::filter(gender3 == "nb") |>
    dplyr::group_by(gender4) |>
    dplyr::summarize(n = dplyr::n())


q <- dplyr::full_join(pgi, ygi, by = c("subjectkey", "eventname")) |>
    dplyr::filter(eventname == "baseline_year_1_arm_1")

q$eventname

q

x <- dplyr::full_join(pgi, ygi, by = c("subjectkey", "eventname")) |>
    dplyr::filter(eventname == "2_year_follow_up_y_arm_1") |>
    dplyr::filter(y_trans == 1)

x

```
